leads.title: CUDA SM86: opt-in one-superblock prefetch build
leads.assessment: CUDA SM86 prefill-only weight prefetch specialization; measured on Linux RTX3060/IQ3_XXS, not current Windows decode. Deferred from decode target.

leads.title: CUDA SM86: opt-in IQ3 two-stage prefill build
leads.assessment: CUDA SM86 selective two-stage IQ3 prefill specialization; same applicability limits. No decode gain claimed.

leads.title: verify: service returns before any CUDA call while nothing has rung (#1740)
leads.assessment: Early exit before CUDA calls in pipelined Verifier::service; current single-GPU path uses Verifier::run instead.

leads.title: route-resident: one warp per token in the swap kernel
leads.assessment: Faster implementation of approximate resident expert routing. The reported speed requires a mode that changes routing and showed distribution/quality distortion. Excluded by this contract.

leads.title: cpu: IQ2_S in the bit-exact singleton rows, and the singleton path only below the #152 rule (stacked on #1415)
leads.assessment: Exact AVX2 singleton optimization for widths below native_gu_mt_min; retained STRATA_IQ_MT_MIN=1 leaves no eligible singleton width. Not a direct gain for current dispatch.

leads.title: decode: STRATA_PCIE_BALANCE=1 picks each layer's PCIe count from measured costs (refile of #1038 by @sergqwer, on 0.1.40.3)
leads.assessment: Runtime fitting of each layer CPU/GPU expert split; report improves the automatic probe but remains slower than its manually tuned fraction. Current fixed0.20 requires its own evaluation; no imported speed claim.
